function total(price = discount()) {
  function discount() {
    return 10;
  }
  return price;
}
function area(size: Side) {
  type Side = number;
  return size * size;
}
function scaled(value = factor) {
  var factor = 2;
  return value * factor;
}
function greet(name = fallback) {
  const fallback = "guest";
  return name;
}
interface Item {
  id: number;
}
function show(item: Item) {
  interface Item {
    name: string;
  }
  return item.id;
}
function delayed(read = () => later) {
  let later = 1;
  return read();
}
function twice(count: number) {
  function count() {}
  return count;
}
function retyped(count: number) {
  var count = "many";
  return count;
}
const later = (step = () => inner()) => {
  function inner() {
    return 1;
  }
  return step();
};
console.log(total, area, scaled, greet, show, delayed, twice, retyped, later);
